findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: One of the soda nozzles and the coffee makers were observed soiled. The PIC was made aware. The PIC removed, cleaned and sanitized them respectively immediately. Ensure that food contact surfaces are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There is observed a hole in the wall near the licenses behind the black curtain. Ensure repairs are made to make this surface smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. This is a repeat violation from the 3/27/2023 Inspection Report and the facility will receive a Warning Notice for this violation. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.114: There is an unused ice machine in the back storage area. This machine needs to be removed from the premises unless it is repaired in to working order. This is a repeat violation from the 3/27/2023 inspection report and the facility will receive a Warning Notice. 
6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The ceiling in the walk-in cooler is observed to be in a state of disrepair. Ensure the ceiling is repaired in a manner that makes it smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.
